desc: This Kimber Magazine is a standard factory replacement magazine. It is designed for use in 1911 pistols with a full-length grip (such as the Kimber Custom and Pro) chambered in .38 Super and holds 9 rounds of ammunition. It is made from high quality steel and features witness holes in the body to see how many rounds are left in the magazine. Additionally, it is worth noting that the magazine is made to Kimber's specifications and tolerances, using the same manufacturing process and materials as the original equipment magazines which shipped with your firearm. This will ensure not only a perfect fit but exceptional operation.
